references.title: Copilot Money — Cash Flow
references.author: Copilot Money / Apple Developer
references.apply: month, balance, breakdown, then transactions. Every amount needs an explicit period.
references.avoid: importing excessive charts, banking integration, AI, or projection formulas.

references.title: Actual Budget — monthly overview
references.author: Actual Budget
references.apply: keep indicator name, amount, and period close together. Each month must be understandable on its own.
references.avoid: importing desktop tables, envelope budgeting, or category limits.

references.title: iPhone Calendar
references.author: Apple
references.apply: distinguish the selected month, year, occurrence date, and today.
references.avoid: requiring a calendar grid as the home screen; the screenshot is in Finnish.

references.title: Monzo — color palette
references.author: Monzo / Ragged Edge (historical reference)
references.apply: give brand color and neutrals distinct roles; concentrate intensity where it guides users.
references.avoid: copying coral as the signature color, typography, or illustrations. Preserve Blubby's semantic colors.

references.title: Wise — mobile components
references.author: Wise / Ness Grixti / Ragged Edge
references.apply: create coherence through typography, radii, spacing, and icons, retaining neutral reading areas.
references.avoid: copying green, typography, currency exchange, navigation, or celebrations after every entry.

references.title: Actual Budget — transactions
references.author: Actual Budget
references.apply: repeat the anatomy of name and amount, supported by date, account/card, and state.
references.avoid: importing desktop columns, hover controls, bulk selection, import, or reconciliation.

references.title: Actual Budget — occurrences and states
references.author: Actual Budget
references.apply: keep written state labels near the occurrence. Canceled records remain legible and available for review.
references.avoid: adopting the reference product's rules, states, or automation as Blubby rules.
references.replacement_reason: The supplied link returned HTTP 404; replaced with the schedules overview from the official documentation.

references.title: Carbon — state alignment
references.author: IBM / Carbon Design System
references.apply: keep icons and labels in stable positions; combine shape and text with color.
references.avoid: importing Carbon icons or treating expenses as severity levels.

references.title: Department for Education — form error
references.author: Department for Education / Claim funding for mentors
references.group: D. Tone of voice and user guidance
references.apply: explain corrections near the field and preserve input.
references.avoid: copying the government layout or that form's validation rules.

references.title: Department for Education — confirmation
references.author: Department for Education / Manage training
references.group: D. Tone of voice and user guidance
references.apply: confirm the action's effect and explain what happens next.
references.avoid: creating a full page or large green panel for every entry. Match feedback to consequences.
